stem.text: A ball is thrown across a flat field.

stem.alt: A grey ball on the left with a dashed curved path rising and then falling to the right. The path is labelled path of ball.

stem.text: Which statement describes the motion of the ball, when the effects of air resistance are ignored?

A.text: The ball lands with the same velocity at which it is thrown.

B.text: The horizontal component of acceleration is constant throughout the motion.

C.text: The horizontal and vertical components of acceleration are both zero at the highest point of the motion.

D.text: The horizontal and vertical components of velocity are both zero at the highest point of the motion.
